title: Best app ever to create new habits!
body:
I will say this is the best app that will help you to create new habits, it is so simple to use and friendly for everyone.
I’ve using this app for like a month and during this month I created the habit of meditate which I need it for some long also it has helping me to track my workout and exercise 4 days a week as lately I was very intermitent just going 1 or 2 day per week.
I strongly recommend this app if you want to improve your life with new habits.

Thanks Kevin! 👌🏻
author: geraguirre

title: One of the best habit apps
body: Congratulations, your app is one of the best habit apps in the market. However one essential feature that is missing for the app to be perfect is habit sharing with friends. Accountability is vital for habit forming; other apps have it where you can see live your friend’s habit and viceversa. Hope you can add it soon! Definitely would make the app the best ever.
